# FlipPiano
A interactive mini piano application for Flipper Zero. Play melodies, view real-time frequencies.

## Features

- 14-key and 2-octave range for playing custom melodies
- Real-time frequency display (Hz) for visual feedback on active notes
- Dedicated volume control menu to adjust or mute sound output
- Clean monochrome pixel UI optimized for the Flipper screen

## Controls

- Left / Right: Navigate between piano keys
- OK: Play selected note
- Up / Down: Open or close volume settings
- BACK: Exit the application
